sequences.story: Lucia helps her mother clean up their dilapidated property, survives an alligator attack in the pool, deals with an armed gang confrontation, and ultimately uses an excavator to demolish the gang's house in retaliation.
A continuous gameplay sequence from leaving the garage in a convertible, driving through rural roads, crashing into a field, flipping the car, and running through the countryside.

The sequence follows the characters touring a suburban house, examining its rooms and backyard amenities, before a sudden argument over real estate strategy escalates into a tense armed standoff in the backyard.
A chronological sequence starting with driving around the trailer park, handling loot storage in car trunks, checking phone notifications, and exploring the in-game map of Port Gellhorn.

A chronological breakdown of modders attempting to run GTA VI assets on PC without the missing .exe, detailing the creation of open-source emulators like ScarlettX and Leonida, analyzing code commits, and examining the challenges of unencrypted asset files versus encrypted archive indexes.

The player conducts a bank heist inside Lombank, loots cash while managing hostages, shoots their way through responding police officers in the lobby, steals a police vehicle to escape downtown, and navigates an intense urban pursuit.
Jason and Lucia execute a bank robbery on a Fleeca Bank branch, cracking safes, collecting bags of cash, dealing with hostages, fighting guards, and escaping in an SUV.
Jason and Lucia navigate a high-intensity 5-star police escape through rural terrain, utilizing cover, changing disguises, and shooting down pursuing helicopters.

The streamers attempt multiple store robberies across Vice City, upgrading their weapons, cracking safes under tight time pressure, dealing with escalating police heat levels, and escaping through city streets.

The player starts on foot near vehicles and bodies, boards a crop duster plane, takes off into the sunset skies, and flies across the open-world map dropping packages while listening to humorous radio dialogue about smuggling and eluding authorities.
The narrative cuts between Jason and Lucia being questioned by police over stolen cars, escalating arguments, and a sudden violent ambush on the officers followed by escaping in a red vehicle.
Lucia carjacks an Ocelot Jugular, drives to Watkins Auto Parts, and negotiates with Moses to prove her car boosting skills.

The streamer navigates through swampy terrain on foot, deals with hostile NPCs and accidentally shoots them with a taser/gun, tries to get a stuck van out of the mud, opens the back doors to discover a tiger, shoots the tiger, and later gets into a UTV vehicle to drive down the highway.

A high-stakes nocturnal getaway starting from a street chase with police cars, breaching an airport security gate, boarding a private jet under fire, and taking off into a tense dogfight against military jets.

The sequence follows Jason Duval from gearing up on the boat, diving into the ocean with NPCs, swimming through a coral trench while bantering, and exploring a shipwreck using a metal detector to hunt for hidden underwater treasure.
Lucia and Papa Audacity complete a mission involving a stadium escape, a stunt jump, street fights with pedestrians, and retrieving a truck to escape the area while commentary plays over the events.
A chronological edit following Jason and Lucia from their police car encounter, argument over driving, subsequent crime spree, and getting back together in Vice City.
The player navigates a high-tension scenario on a luxury hotel rooftop in Vice City, fighting police, tackling NPCs, and surviving helicopter attacks while maintaining a high wanted level.

A complete sequence following characters at a nighttime street gathering in Vice City where they dance on vehicles, get into altercations, vandalize a car with spray paint and baseball bats, and finally escape through the city streets.
Jason explores the coastal lighthouse, meets Lucia at the top for a romantic view and kiss, then experiences an accidental fall down the interior shaft.

A sustained 6-star police chase beginning inside a military base, breaking out onto country roads, crossing bridges towards Vice City, battling N.O.O.S.E. units and helicopters, and eventually culminating in a 'wasted' screen after extensive damage.

The streamer explores an abstract cosmic environment containing floating planets, inspects holographic models of celestial bodies, and interacts with planetary spheres to view detailed aerial map projections of Vice City landscape and geography.

A continuous sequence of open-world exploration and mission driving, starting with the auto-drive feature discovery, navigating through traffic and bridges, experiencing a severe collision, and arriving at the warehouse to talk to NPCs.

A sustained sequence showing the player character retrieving data, escaping across cranes under helicopter fire, navigating collapsing walkways, fighting through a multi-level showroom, and attempting to rescue teammates.
The sequence follows the player stealing a jet, performing chaotic low-altitude flights through the city, getting wasted, and then exploring street-level interactions with NPCs.

Jason and Lucia navigate through Vice City streets in a turquoise sports car, dealing with vehicle damage, using smartphone apps to manage transportation, and driving along the highway amidst traffic.
Lucia and Jason work security at the VYB nightclub in Vice City, managing VIP entries, interacting with guests at the door, checking in on sections, and balancing crowd hype and revenue.

Lucia explores Vice City at dusk, interacts with valet staff, checks her phone for mission waypoints, steals sports cars, and navigates city streets while communicating with contacts about upcoming jobs.
Jason attempts various street and store robberies across Vice City, dealing with fleeing NPCs, police chases, and safe cracking.
The player navigates a tense shootout at a hangar, manages inventory and weapon switching, fights through waves of enemies, and escapes across rooftops and swamp paths under heavy police pursuit.
A sustained look at vehicle mechanics, damage modeling, custom resprays, environmental weather effects like rain wipers on first-person phone view, and business delivery vehicles.

Lucia navigates the motel complex, checks on her boyfriend Jason in room 06, visits Vicki in room 10 to negotiate for pain medication, smokes from a bong, pays Vicki money, and returns the pills to Jason.
The player navigates Vice City on a motorcycle, visits the Au Courant hair salon for character customizations for both Lucia and Jason, and then checks out a jewelry store location.
Lucia and Jason navigate from a street meeting to the High Life Hotel, infiltrate the rooftop party at Acai Dreams, and confront Giorgio Gallo with a hard drive.
A compilation of bizarre encounters featuring tigers in vans, cows chasing vehicles, drive-thru altercations, and wildlife attacks.
An infiltration and combat sequence through a high-end party venue, showcasing stealth takedowns, hallway gunfights, and tense room clearing.

A complete sequence showing a cutscene on a rooftop discussing a bank robber named Raul, transitioning to Lucia riding a motorcycle across Vice City, reaching a parked delivery van, changing into work clothes, and infiltrating the container port to search for target cargo.

Jason and Lucia start inside their apartment, discuss heading out to an antique store, talk to neighbors outside about neighborhood drama, get into a red convertible, and drive through the city streets discussing the high value of stolen statues.
The player drives around Vice City at night, crashes into pedestrians and a tiki bar, interacts with NPCs, and escalates into a massive shootout with police ending in a 'wasted' screen.
Jason and Lucia drive through Vice City, stop at a gas station, and explore the interior store and backrooms.

The player explores the docks, interacts with wildlife, strolls through downtown Vice City at sunset, visits clothing stores, hangs out in a club lounge, and ends up in an escalating police chase after stealing a tour bus.
Lucia and Jason leave the beach on jet skis, navigate the map, run through hotel grounds, and use their phones to order a sports car.

Jason stashes his money under the floorboards, explores his living quarters, takes a phone call from Brian about rent collection, rides his motorcycle through Key Lento, and drives down the highway while taking another phone call.
Jason travels through South Vice-Dale County, checks his phone, visits the smoke shop to speak with Papo, experiences map glitches, and reloads a saved game to continue the story.

Jason starts at his Key Lento safehouse, checks his mailbox for a cash payout from Brian, shoots hoops at the basketball hoop, stashes cash under the floorboards, works on home renovations including drywall and repairing exterior stairs, changes his outfit in the wardrobe, and drives off in his Vapid truck.

Jason and Lucia track down Benedict Halifax at a Vice City motel, confront him in his room, discover him in an embarrassing situation, and interrogate him at gunpoint for stolen credit cards and a missing statue.
The player navigates through various missions, evades police, steals vehicles, and completes objectives across the map.
Jason roams around the Vice City waterfront piers while the streamer delivers an extended review and critique of the game's story, graphics, and performance.
Lucia and Jason infiltrate a Vice City tanning salon, distract the front desk, sneak into the back rooms, trap a target inside a tanning bed, and hack his phone to uncover reservation details.
Lucia explores multiple beachside shops, tries on different clothing items, accessories, and hats, makes purchases, and navigates through the coastal town in a red Declasse Tulip with Jason.
Jason navigates through Vice City, completes mission objectives, engages in shootouts at a lab, manages phone messages regarding relationship status, and explores apartment buildings.
The player navigates through open-world missions involving bank surveillance, security van tailing, and shootouts with law enforcement in Vice City.
A complete street race sequence featuring high speeds, traffic dodging, dramatic crashes, and vehicle flips.

Jason and Lucia walk through a gym facility, enter the locker room where Lucia interacts with a QR code poster on the wall using her phone, receive an automated recruitment message, and later exit onto the streets of Vice City where they encounter pedestrians and check their phone messages.

The gameplay sequence starts with a high-intensity rooftop shootout and rooftop escape in a red sports car, transitions through city driving and street navigation, continues with a quick clothing store stop at NOLA, and culminates in driving over to the Doigt D'Or hotel for a poolside meeting with contacts.
